firstPlayerRule: The triangles on the randomly drawn key card show which team starts. That team’s Spymaster gives the first clue.
clarifications: The starting team receives the double-agent tile and must find one more picture than the other team. Teams alternate turns.
Each team chooses its Spymaster during setup.
